requested_settings.selection_basis: Collected MIT Qlib price definitions, no predictive results inspected; one variant per definition family
requested_settings.label: close[t+h]/close[t]-1; signal after close[t]; price diagnostic only, no execution claims
requested_settings.preprocessing: none; complete pairs; no fill, clipping, winsorization or cross-sectional rank
requested_settings.incremental_baseline: OLS intercept + trailing 1-bar return; augmented with one factor; fit/scaling only in early sample with purged label boundary; late sample MSE comparison descriptive only

excluded.volume_features: Native base/quote unit not certified for the selected dataset; not needed
excluded.RSI: No reviewed selected source mapping; Wilder/EMA/SMA smoothing not interchangeable
excluded.cross_sectional: Only one accepted asset; no simultaneous PIT universe or industry neutralization

lookback.scope: minimum structural input span; includes current observation

definitions.rights_scope: Collected definitions/metadata only; excludes underlying market observations and upstream third-party rights.
definitions.universe: configurable equity universe; no fixed market assumed
